page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number left. One text column at right, with a narrow column of marginal notes at its left. Text is in one block; no other blocks.

main_text.p: Vtinam illud Thomæ, qui Iuftificationem tribuit operibus, non fecundum quod Iuftificatio dicitur Iuftitiæ infufio, fed fecundum quod dicitur Iuftitiæ Exercitatio, vel oftenfio,vel confummatio ; pax quidem nobis iftic alta foret, vereque folida : At dum Tridentini patres inhærentem nobis iuftitiam, formalem Iuftificationis caufam commini-fcuntur, fidemque exturbant, ecquis bonus non arma ftatim meditetur,mortemq; oppetat potius, quàm vt auitam fidem inani fomnio corrumpi patia-tur ?
In Galat. & in lac.2. Concil. Trid. Seff.6.c.7. Si quis dixerit sola fide, &c. Can.9.

page.notes: The marginal notes at left are: "In Galat. & in lac. 2." beside the first lines of the column, and "Concil. Trid. Seff. 6. c. 7. Si quis dixerit sola fide, &c. Can. 9." beside the middle lines. Text at the very bottom "tur ?" is the continuation of the last line. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
